title: Budew 004/131 Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon Card Poke Ball Reverse Holo
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Budew 004/131 Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon Card features a Grass-type attribute, standard card size, and a Pokeball speciality from the Prismatic Evolutions set. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, this English-language card is a common rarity, featuring the character Budew in a Basic stage with a Reverse Holo finish. This collectible card game item is perfect for fans of Pokémon TCG looking to add a unique and rare card to their collection.
